name: 3D Kenji Devcontainer
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'cd /workspace && if grep -qs " /workspace/.venv " /proc/mounts; then echo "postCreate: skip .venv cleanup (mounted volume)"; else echo "postCreate: remove .venv"; rm -rf .venv; fi && if [ -f .venv/pyvenv.cfg ]; then echo "postCreate: .venv exists, skip venv create"; else uv venv --python 3.11; fi && if [ -f .venv/.installed ]; then echo "postCreate: deps already installed, skip install"; else uv pip install -e . && touch .venv/.installed; fi && bash scripts/bootstrap-mcp.sh --ensure-env'
